units.unitTitle: Pali Language, Traditions and Salient Features of Pāli Grammar
units.unitTitleMr: पाली भाषा, परंपरा आणि पाली व्याकरणाची मुख्य वैशिष्ट्ये
topics: Derivation of the word 'Pāli', Homeland of Pāli language; Three traditions of Pali grammar: Kaccāyanvyākaraṇa, Moggallānavyākaraṇa and Saddanītivyākaraṇa
Pāli Alphabets: number of alphabets and characteristics

What is Vinaya? Nature of Vinayapiṭaka, Parts of Vinayapiṭaka

Suttapiṭaka: Definition and nature, classification according to nikāyas, nature and structure of nikāyas, classification of nikāyas, number of suttas, characteristics of nikayas
Dīghanikāya: Sāmaññaphalasutta, Kūṭadantasutta, Sigālovādasutta

Dhammapada: Yamakavagga, Appamādavagga and Cittavagga
Suttanipāta: Kasibhāradvājasutta, Vāseṭṭhasutta, Parābhavasutta

Dhammasaṅgaṇī: Tikamātikā and Dukamātikā
Handbooks of Abhidhamma: Abhidhammatthasaṅgaha: nature and characteristics, Citta, Cetasika, Rūpa and Nibbāna (Chapter 1, 2 and 6)
